label: The decay constant inside a barrier
section: The decay constant inside a barrier
subgoals: Form the barrier height above the carrier energy
Scale by the effective mass ratio and divide by 0.0381 eV nm squared
Take the square root to get kappa in inverse nanometres

label: Transmission through a barrier
subgoals: Multiply two times kappa by the barrier thickness
Exponentiate the negative result for the transmission
Convert to log base ten when the value is very small

label: Sensitivity to thickness
subgoals: Cancel the prefactor by taking a ratio
Exponentiate two kappa times the thickness change
Relate the result to leakage variation and high-k scaling
